bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
A="$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}' 2>/dev/null)" || exit 61
C="$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:search-color-5a93de6 --format '{{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null)" || exit 62
L="$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null)" || exit 63
R="$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null)" || exit 64
test "$R" = true || exit 65
if [ "$A" = "$C" ]; then exit 0; fi
if [ "$A" = "$L" ]; then exit 41; fi
if [ "$C" = "$L" ]; then exit 42; fi
exit 43
